title: Payment Arrangement Energy Assistance Relief on Reinstatement
content:
# Payment Arrangement Energy Assistance Relief on Reinstatement

**Rule.** When a defaulted Standard Deferred Payment Agreement or Extended Deferred Payment Agreement of the Payment Arrangement program is reinstated, the assistance relief recognises recent payments made on the customer's behalf by an energy assistance agency:

| Payments from an energy assistance agency posted to the Electric Service Agreement within the 6 months before the request | Assistance relief |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 4% |
| Exactly one | 2% |
| None | 0 |

The payments counted are those on the Electric Service Agreement's payment records whose channel is an energy assistance agency. Payments made by the customer through any other channel do not count. A window of 6 months before the request covers payments posted after the same calendar day 6 months earlier, up to and including the request date.

## Worked readings (hypothetical request dated November 5)

| Agency payments posted | Inside the window (after May 5, up to November 5) | Relief |
|---|---|---|
| May 5 and October 1 | One (October 1) | 2% |
| June 2 and October 1 | Two | 4% |
| April 20 | None | 0 |
